<title>Day6</title>
<fragment>

**Day6** (Korean: 데이식스; RR: *De-i-sik-seu*; stylized in all caps) is a South Korean pop rock band under the label JYP Entertainment. The group debuted on September 7, 2015, with the EP *The Day,* which peaked at No.2 on *Billboard*'s World Album Chart a week following its release.[1] The band consists of four members: Sungjin, Young K, Wonpil, and Dowoon. Originally a six-member band, Junhyeok departed on February 27, 2016, and Jae departed on December 31, 2021.[2][3] All of the Day6 members are heavily involved in writing, composing, and producing the band's music.


</fragment>
<fragment>

In 2017, the band released two songs every month of the year for their *Every Day6* project. By the end of the project, 25 songs were added to their discography. With genres ranging from hard rock and upbeat sing-a-longs to mellow ballads. Their first full-length album, *Sunrise,* consisted of songs released in the first half of the *Every Day6* project.[4] It was number 14 on *Billboard*'s *The 25 Greatest K-Pop Albums of the 2010s: Staff List,*[5] and the project kick-off song "I Wait" was placed No.81 on *Billboard*'s *The 100 Greatest K-Pop Songs of the 2010s: Staff List.*[6]

***The Book of Us: Entropy*** is the third Korean-language studio album by South Korean band Day6. It was released by JYP Entertainment on October 22, 2019.[1][2] The lead single "Sweet Chaos" was released the same day. The album debuted at number four on the Gaon Album Chart.




## Background and release

[edit]


</fragment>
<fragment>
1. **^** Park, Boram (October 22, 2019). "DAY6 returns with 3rd full album 'The Book of Us: Entropy'". *Yonhap News Agency*. Retrieved October 28, 2019.
2. **^** Park, Dong-sun (October 21, 2019). "DAY6, 신곡 'Sweet Chaos' 뮤비티저 공개…'흑백 시크함 속 빠른 인트로 전개'". *Naver* (in Korean). Retrieved October 29, 2019.
3. **^** Kim, Hyo-jin (September 30, 2019). "[팩트체크] 데이식스(DAY6), 10월 22일 컴백…JYP 측 "자세한 사항은 추후 공개"". *topstarnews* (in Korean). Retrieved October 29, 2019.
4. **^** Sun, Mi-kyung (October 22, 2019). "데이식스, 오늘(22일) 정규3집 컴백..11트랙 모두 명곡 예감[공식]". *Osen*. Retrieved October 29, 2019.
5. **^** Cha, Hye-Mi (October 22, 2019). "'컴백 D-DAY' 데이식스, 샘플러 영상 공개! 11개 트랙 모두 명곡 예감". *MBC*. Retrieved October 29, 2019.
6. ^ ***a*** ***b*** ***c*** Park, Boram (October 22, 2019). "DAY6 returns with 3rd full album 'The Book of Us: Entropy'". *Yonhap News Agency*. Retrieved April 25, 2020.

</fragment>
<fragment>
On September 28, 2019, it was reported that Day6 would be returning with new music in October after fans discovered an advertisement at a subway station depicting Day6's logo with the date October 22 and the time 6 pm. Day6's agency JYP Entertainment later confirmed, "it is true that Day6 will come back on October 22".[3] On October 6, 2019, a prologue film entitled *The Book of Us: Entropy* was released on Youtube. Pre-orders for the physical album opened on October 7, it became available in two versions: "Sweet" and "Chaos". On October 8, 2019, the tracklist was released, consisting of 11 new tracks. On October 10, individual "graphic image" teasers for each member were released. Following that, a series of individual and group photo teasers were revealed from October 11–20. The first music video teaser for the lead single "Sweet Chaos" was released on October 20 and an album sampler was revealed the following day.[4][5]

Based on my search of Day6's discography information from Wikipedia, here's what I can tell you about their Korean-language studio albums:

## Day6's Korean Studio Albums

1. **Sunrise** (2017)
   - Release date: June 7, 2017
   - 14 tracks compiled from their Every Day6 monthly releases from January-June 2017
   - Notable singles: "I Wait", "You Were Beautiful", "How Can I Say", "I'm Serious", "Dance Dance", "I Smile"
   - Peak positions: #4 on Gaon Album Chart (South Korea), #6 on US World Albums

2. **Moonrise** (2017) 
   - Release date: December 6, 2017
   - 18 tracks featuring Every Day6 releases from July-November 2017 plus final versions of songs from their first EP
   - Notable singles: "Hi Hello", "What Can I Do", "I Loved You", "When You Love Someone", "All Alone", "I Like You"
   - Peak position: #2 on Gaon Album Chart

3. **The Book of Us: Entropy** (2019)
   - Release date: October 22, 2019
   - 11 tracks with "Sweet Chaos" as the lead single
   - Part of their "The Book of Us" series
   - Peak position: #4 on Gaon Album Chart

4. **The Decade** (2024)
   - This is listed as their fourth Korean studio album in their discography
   - Very recent release, so detailed information may not be fully available yet

**Note:** Day6 also has one Japanese studio album called "Unlock" (2018), but you specifically asked about their Korean-language albums.

Would you like more detailed information about any specific album?
